name: oBot
description: The web crawler of the Content Security Division of IBM Germany Research & Development, which crawls pages and classifies their content into more than 65 categories to build the URL-filter database shipped in IBM's content filtering products and OEM SDK. The crawler page explains that the name predates IBM — it comes from ONLY Solutions GmbH, which built the crawler in the late 1990s — and that the token was deliberately never renamed so that existing robots.txt entries keep working. The operator documents its user agent, its address ranges and a hostname to check them against.
